## Evidence

Kind: visual

- **A slower swallow, presentation only:** a fall takes up to 2.4 s (`SingularitySpaghetti.FallSeconds`, was 1.6; the
  shortest 1.2, was 0.8), the implosion's swallow 0.6 s (was 0.38, the well's `_ImplodeTime` with it), and a swallowed
  ship dims later and less (60% at most from u = 0.3, was 80% by u = 0.6), so it is seen as itself as it stretches. The
  simulation's 3 s pull (`SingularityLanceRules.PullSeconds`) is unchanged, so a ship caught late still has only the time
  left before the hole closes.

Round 4 clips (2026-10-20 16:03 to 16:22, Mac release player of B, `/srv/fff/review/w1470-singularity-lance-structure/`, `note-7.md`): `w1470-r4-B-fire-close.mp4` and `-halfspeed.mp4` (wind-up 1.0-2.8 s, the orb leaves frame left at about 3.1 s), `w1470-r4-B-fire-wide-orb-leaving.mp4` (orb in flight 2.8-3.1 s), `w1470-r4-B-guardian-swallowed-over-nexus.mp4` and `-halfspeed.mp4` (hole opens about 3.9 s, the Guardian stretches in about 4.0-5.6 s), `w1470-r4-B-raid-swallowed.mp4` and a cropped `-close-crop-halfspeed-3.0-7.0s.mp4` (hole about 3.4-6.4 s), frame sheets every 0.2 s, and watch_video's second opinion on the close firing take and the Guardian take. 49-55 new frames per second (measured, mpdecimate); the game's own counter read 12 fps for about 0.4 s at the charge's start in the close take only (1.15-1.52 s near-still), 61-66 fps through the same moment in the wide take (measured on its overlay), so a one-off hitch, not a per-shot cost; 31 fps for one reading as the Guardian's hole opens. Looked: yes, every take stepped at full resolution. Second-opinion flags checked: "no projectile fires" in the close take is the framing (the orb leaves frame left within 0.2 s; the wide take shows it); "an unlit black ring segment" at 4.3 s is the ring's shaded side in my frames; "the Guardian disappears at once" is its glowing hull going to the ghost's lit hull at capture (it then stretches in over about 1.6 s, `w1470-r4-B-guardian-swallow-every-0.2s-3.4-6.2s.png`); "a secondary explosion" at 7.2 s is the Guardian's Structure Energy Cell growing in after the hole (round 3), not at the hole; "draws over the station ring" is the well's draw-over-everything that Ben asked for on 2026-10-19.
